assumptions.dayBoundary: Local sunrise (panchangam value prevailing at sunrise defines the calendar day)
assumptions.note: Astronomically computed. May occasionally differ by ±1 day from a specific temple's published panchangam near tithi/nakshatra boundary edge cases.

events.name: Hanuman Jayanti
events.basis: Amavasai tithi in Tamil month Margazhi (Tamil Nadu convention)
events.description: Hanuman's birthday, marked with recitations of the Hanuman Chalisa and visits to Hanuman temples.
events.significance: Widely observed at South Indian Hanuman temples on this date; North India instead keeps Chaitra Purnima.
